# `photos`

Helper: `photos(items, { n, sq })` (alias `photoGrid`)  
Kit (`src/ui`): kit gap · status: kit gap  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `LocalPhoto` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Grid of 3:2 placeholder tiles with the tag "MINH HỌA TỔNG HỢP", label and meta under each.

## Variants

- Default
- `empty: true` (missing photo)
- `slider: true` (compare slider)
- `sq`: square tiles, tag at the bottom

## States

- Static: it has no hover, focus or disabled state of its own

## Tokens

tile, brand-100, brand-500, line, surface, ink-soft, radius-tile

## Do

- Always keep the tag "MINH HỌA TỔNG HỢP"
- Placeholders only

## Don't

- Never show real or generated faces, never score improvement from a placeholder

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Gap 16.

## Mobile (390)

Grid follows the parent (usually 2 columns).

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

Placeholders only, always with the tag "MINH HỌA TỔNG HỢP"; `{ empty: true }` for a missing photo, `{ slider: true }` for the slider compare; `sq` = square tiles with the tag at the bottom (Patient Mobile compare)
